mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_agent_background_task WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_background_task ( session_id, task_id, type, status, description, command, agent_id, agent_type, prompt, output, error_msg, total_tool_use_count, total_duration_ms, started_at_ms, ended_at_ms, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{taskId}, #{type}, #{status}, #{description}, #{command}, #{agentId}, #{agentType}, #{prompt}, #{output}, #{errorMsg}, #{totalToolUseCount}, #{totalDurationMs}, #{startedAtMs}, #{endedAtMs}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE type = VALUES(type), status = VALUES(status), description = VALUES(description), command = VALUES(command), agent_id = VALUES(agent_id), agent_type = VALUES(agent_type), prompt = VALUES(prompt), output = VALUES(output), error_msg = VALUES(error_msg), total_tool_use_count = VALUES(total_tool_use_count), total_duration_ms = VALUES(total_duration_ms), started_at_ms = VALUES(started_at_ms), ended_at_ms = VALUES(ended_at_ms), deleted = 0, update_time = NOW()
